paper.title: Assessing the impact of jumps in an option pricing model: A gradient estimation approach

simulation.mrjd_ratio_definition: Follow the plotted E[abs(J)]/sigma axis and preserve the signed mean E[J] as stated on p.747. Solve both moment constraints for beta means at fixed sign probability. The conflicting lambda/(beta_plus-beta_minus) prose is not used; alternatives are separate diagnostics.
simulation.mrjd_positive_jump_probability_interpret: Paper-specified in the numerical-study double-exponential density: pi_plus=pi_minus=0.5.

merton.mean_log_jump_interpretation: Table 1 mu_J is interpreted as the mean log jump; the article also uses mu_J for a drift quantity, so this mapping is an explicit ambiguity rather than a certain transcription.

mrjd.diffusion_market_price_of_risk_interpret: Equation (8) includes a diffusion market-price adjustment lambda^M * sigma, but the numerical section gives no value; this reconstruction sets lambda^M=0.

cases.contract_basis: Example 4 and the in-panel headings specify a put; captions say call. The call is retained as a separate sensitivity case.
